name: aurelix-dev-launcher
description: Development launcher for the Python-based AURELIX service.

scripts.dev: PYTHONPATH=src AURELIX_HOST=0.0.0.0 AURELIX_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn aurelix_core.server:app --reload
scripts.start: PYTHONPATH=src AURELIX_HOST=0.0.0.0 AURELIX_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn aurelix_core.server:app
